fn solve(n: Int, k: Int, a: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (n >= 1)
  requires (k >= 1)
  requires (len(a) == n)
  requires forall i in 0..len(a): (a[i] >= 1)
  requires exists i in 0..len(a): ((k % a[i]) == 0)
  ensures (result >= 1)
  ensures exists i in 0..len(a): ((((a[i] >= 1) and ((k % a[i]) == 0)) and (forall i_1 in 0..len(a): ((not ((a[i_1] >= 1) and ((k % a[i_1]) == 0))) or (a[i_1] <= a[i])))) and (result == (k / a[i])))
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0, []) == 0)
{
  0
